facts.fact: 战后第一夜无庆功：孩子们兴奋难眠、满身血污，Giada 与 Wendy 劝他们先洗（血腥味招野兽）；火边只剩 Peter、Wendy、Giada、Tinker Bell 与远处吹萨克斯的 Tito
Tinker Bell 认错「是我的错」，Peter 附和「没错」，Giada 反驳「我们瞎冲，Dal Mare 有计划」；Tinker Bell 讲精灵断代史：19–20 世纪之交 Enchantment 退走西方，工业与烟碾过去
facts.anchor: by the calendar of Flesh, Enchantment moved away

facts.fact: Tinker Bell 揭出 Luisa 是「换子」精灵：她为一个男人放弃本族长寿（已活近一世纪），本相是精灵；被换走时她正死于痨病，那次交换是礼物
facts.anchor: Luisa made herself a woman for him, but her original nature was that of a fairy.

facts.fact: Wendy 问怎么处理 Giovanni；Peter 说「选择在 Wendy」，Wendy 答「选择不在我，在他」
facts.anchor: The choice isn’t mine. It’s his.

facts.fact: Giovanni 一夜未眠，脑内「控告者」与「辩护者」互审；黎明 Augusto 请他吃早餐，告知 Luisa 是精灵、是叛逆的一支
facts.anchor: His mind has been split in two, the Accuser and the Defender.

facts.fact: Augusto 的神学：Peter 是真神 Pan——rape 与无度享乐之神，要让同类开路、让凡人做奴隶；他自认手下非圣人，只求「物证」；Giovanni 反问「你亲眼见我做了什么」
facts.anchor: Pan, the god of rape and wanton pleasure

facts.fact: Giovanni 问「制服找谁领」——以复仇为名投入 Hook 阵营
facts.anchor: “Who do I need to talk to about a uniform?”

facts.fact: Giada 与 Wendy 在河里争论「这座岛生物学上说不通」；Giada 引普鲁塔克：潘随基督降世而死，后世把撒旦塑成羊腿模样；她说「Hook 未必比 Peter 少一点神性」
facts.anchor: Plutarch, you know, the Roman author

facts.fact: 正午沙滩：Peter 裸身晒太阳，回忆阿卡迪亚牧人怕他显形；宣布返罗马「适应新时代」，把岛上防务交给 Exalted Strategist 与 Just Exalted，自己去找 Retinue 的女孩
facts.anchor: I must return to Rome, understand the new age. Adapt.

facts.fact: 当夜 Tinker Bell 赴「游泳之约」：她雌雄同体、可现男身；与 Wendy、Giada 交合，Wendy 在高潮后与 Giada 一同飞离地面；Tinker Bell 说「仙尘——你以为是什么？」
facts.anchor: “Fairy dust,” she says. “What did you think it was?”

numbers.anchor: She had already lived almost a century

numbers.what: Augusto 说十五年前会强迫 Giovanni 留下

relations.what: 精灵，讲断代史并揭 Luisa 身世，章末以身体教飞
Hook，以早餐与神学收编 Giovanni

relations.what: 换子精灵，为 Giovanni 自贬为人
relations.anchor: her original nature was that of a fairy
